signals_info.description: Distance from the ego vehicle to the nearest relevant front obstacle.

nl_Literal_translation_en: For the next 2 seconds, the distance to the front obstacle shall remain greater than 10 meters.
nl_Literal_translation_zh: 在接下来的 2 秒内，与前方障碍物的距离应始终大于 10 米。
nl_Paraphrase_en: During the first 2 seconds of the AEB monitoring interval, the vehicle shall continuously maintain more than 10 meters of clearance from the front obstacle.
nl_Paraphrase_zh: 在 AEB 监测区间开始后的 2 秒内，车辆与前方障碍物应持续保持大于 10 米的距离。
